INFORMATION BUYERS NEED BEFORE TRUSTING A 60/70 QUOTATION.

This summary keeps the procurement view visible while the tabs below preserve the full product detail, specifications, formulation, applications, packaging, and MSDS/SDS content.

PURITY / GRADE

High-grade petroleum-derived paving grade bitumen (Penetration Grade 60/70) offering excellent adhesion, durability, and resistance to thermal cracking and rutting.

RELEVANT STANDARDS

Can be referenced against international penetration grade specifications such as ASTM D946 or AASHTO M20, applicable destination road authority standards, and safety data (SDS) requirements. Standards are references, not a certification.

TYPICAL EXPORT PACKAGING

New steel drums, bulk bitumen tankers, or flexitanks packed for international maritime transport to your destination port.

PRIMARY APPLICATIONS

Road construction, asphalt paving, highway maintenance, and waterproofing applications.

INFORMATION REQUIRED

Send these items to sales@petrobindglobal.com so we can address them together in our response and keep the exchange to as few rounds as possible.

TYPICAL SPECIFICATIONS — 60/70

Values shown are typical reference ranges, not a commercial guarantee. Test methods are named as references, not certifications. The Certificate of Analysis for the confirmed lot governs.

SPECIFICATION VALUE / RANGE TEST METHOD
Penetration at 25 C (100g, 5s) 60-70 (0.1 mm) ASTM D5
Softening Point (Ring & Ball) 49-56 C ASTM D36
Ductility at 25 C Min. 100 cm (typical) ASTM D113
Flash Point (Cleveland Open Cup) Min. 250 C (typical) ASTM D92
Solubility in trichloroethylene Min. 99.0% wt (typical) ASTM D2042
Loss on heating (mass change) Reported on COA ASTM D6
Spot test Reported on COA AASHTO T102

INSIGHT FOR BUYERS

Malaysia & international reference standards

PetroBind's Bitumen 60/70 grades are selected based on strict physical properties that match the technical thresholds required by standard Malaysian paving frameworks (MS 124 & JKR/SPJ/2008). The same penetration, softening point, ductility, flash point and solubility tests are referenced internationally under ASTM D946, AASHTO M20 and EN 12591.
